* [[Prince Laurent of Belgium]] marries British-born '[[commoner]]' [[Princess Claire of Belgium|Claire Coombs]] at the [[St. Michael and Gudula Cathedral]] in [[Brussels]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&u=%2Fafp%2F20030412%2Fen_afp%2Fbelgium_royals_people_030412150644 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2019-07-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041101175127/http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&u=%2Fafp%2F20030412%2Fen_afp%2Fbelgium_royals_people_030412150644 |archive-date=2004-11-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Poet [[Linda Gregerson]] receives the $100,000 [[Kingsley Tufts Poetry Award]] for her collection ''Waterborne''.  The award is presented annually by the [[Claremont Graduate University]] for a "mid-career poet".  [[Joanie Mackowski]] receives the $10,000 Kate Tufts Discovery Award.
* Canadian scientists announce that they have sequenced the [[genome]] of the [[virus]] which is thought to cause [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome]]. The sequence is published on their website: http://www.bcgsc.ca/bioinfo/SARS/. (News item:<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/newsitems/s831165.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040220120126/http://www.abc.net.au/news/newsitems/s831165.htm |archive-date=2004-02-20 |url-status=dead }}</ref>)
